Question: For the positive integer \(n,\) let \(\langle n \rangle\) denote the sum of all the positive divisors of \(n\) with the exception of \(n\) itself. For example, \(\langle 4 \rangle = 1 + 2 = 3\) and \(\langle 12 \rangle = 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 6 = 16.\) What is \(\langle\langle\langle 6 \rangle\rangle\rangle?\)
